description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquire the land in Ruwanpura, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District for the Construction of Access Road of Yahalathenna Service Reservoir
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for servitude rights related to a water supply project. It contains detailed land descriptions including location, boundaries, area measurements, and claimant information, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the main purpose of the notice, which is the land acquisition process.
